source_state: Pinned working tree on baseline_commit, including the separately reviewed projection metadata dispatch candidate e4a467f1; source pins describe the audit snapshot, not subsequent documentation edits.
scope: Read the five foundation inventory groups plus the non-Qwen supplement, current progress/design/catalog and the cited current interfaces. Source-only: no new build, run, GPU, network, remote action, product or document edit.

conclusion.meaning: These inputs do not substantiate a concrete outstanding feature implementation list corresponding to the board percentage remainders. They do substantiate unfinished source audit domains and explicit evidence limits. This bounded review cannot prove that all current-hardware capabilities or all selected-role contracts have been exhausted.
conclusion.percentages: 82/85/70/82 and their child percentages are workload estimates. They neither count missing mechanisms nor justify a claim of 100% feature coverage.

remaining_items.fact: The catalog has eight selected families and 33 derivative entries. Its own source/header/profile descriptions explicitly are not a complete per-role GA implementation verdict. The bounded routing inventory found no new reachable routing gap in the branches inspected; static FP8, NF4/F16, MLX, CT and E4/Q8/F32 cache fixes are already implemented.
remaining_items.why_bottom_layer: A source role -> stored codec/layout -> activation/compute/output -> Graph qualification discontinuity would be a real import/math/dispatch gap; lack of every publisher payload result alone is not one.
remaining_items.minimum_next_step: For each still-unclassified selected profile in the existing catalog, assign source-only implemented / known missing producer-reader connection / explicit numerical or hardware limitation / payload evidence absent. Start with an already cached header/role not covered by the recorded inventories. Open implementation only for a concrete discontinuity, without reacquiring whole models or predeclaring all precision combinations.

remaining_items.fact: The reviewed Qwen and GLM journeys already use bounded enqueue, open turns, output credit, pause/wake, whole-episode retirement, survivor requeue and immutable checkpoint/rebuild. Current source preserves actual retirement plus Status separately. The inventories expressly do not prove every callback/endpoint/config invalidation or reentry path across all selected adapters.
remaining_items.why_bottom_layer: Lost commit/owner/retirement facts or a reusable resource released before an actual gate would be a bottom-layer bug. Which legal FIFO quantum, cancel policy or fail-fast policy an application chooses is not a new mechanism.
remaining_items.minimum_next_step: Close the remaining responsibility audit against a named existing adapter/endpoint and one exact failure or lifetime journey at a time, using the existing source contracts. Classify source-confirmed bug separately from unexecuted native failure. No blanket poison, new manager, scheduler, registry or generic wrapper.

remaining_items.fact: Some publisher derivatives remain header/descriptor or selected-role numerical evidence; static FP8 audited 85 of 208 module headers and executed one original role, not all payloads. GGUF NVFP4/HF NVFP4/local dynamic and other selected expert profiles have separately documented payload limits. Large-model upstream activations and omitted layers remain explicit fixtures.
remaining_items.why_not_implementation_gap: Unrun full artifacts or more original experts do not demonstrate an absent codec/bank/permission/execution primitive. Likewise one original role must not be promoted to full-model support.
remaining_items.minimum_next_step: Retain profile-specific source/payload status. Only when a concrete functionality check needs a missing role should its bounded acquisition or component run be planned; this audit neither requests downloads nor declares those profiles fully validated.

remaining_items.fact: GLM Flash startup ran original FP8 positions0..4 on CPU; GLM Pro actual index/target ran CUDA widths1..4 while intervening bodies were fixtures; Kimi original KDA0->MLA3 skipped intervening layers; DS Flash early/SWA boundary ran but a new original Pro position0 numerical run was not in that proof. Existing mathematical support is distinct from these precise executed scopes.
remaining_items.why_not_implementation_gap: Absence of fused multi-token prefill, every R/T shape, every native backend or every derivative run is not evidence that ordinary tokens or full state cannot be consumed and committed.
remaining_items.minimum_next_step: Preserve the explicit executed/unexecuted boundaries; add only a finite check needed by an actual source change or an unresolved contract. Do not turn all cross-products into feature work or infer empty-history failure from a positive physical cache capacity.

remaining_items.fact: There is actual CUDA runtime arrival/credit/cancel/survivor coverage, CPU midturn eviction/restore and local participant-failure coverage, two-Model teardown-survivor coverage and known-byte shared budget coverage. Synthetic Status/NaN checks are not physical device faults; CUDA primary context is shared, opaque/private allocations are not an all-process VRAM cap, and no SLA or cross-Model throughput/fairness claim follows.
remaining_items.why_not_implementation_gap: Existing release/credit/queue primitives and legal serial-owner policy are functional. Arbitrary native retry/preemption, physical VRAM total control and server scheduling guarantees are not promised capabilities to invent for this goal.
remaining_items.minimum_next_step: Report these limits alongside the finite evidence. A future changed native error/retirement path may justify a targeted regression; no new fault injection, mixed-placement or fairness benchmark matrix is requested here.
